statement: For each definition hole listed in the nine upstream openai/math Comparator configs that declare definition_names (Brenier, DefocusingNLS, ElementaryPositivity, EuclideanFiveColor, KServer, Naimark, OccupiedOverlap, Rokhlin, SpinAngle; 45 hole names in total), the solution's declaration of that name either reproduces the challenge's declaration (so a Comparator pass would certify the challenge's intended meaning) or it does not / cannot be checked. Comparator's definitionHoleMatches compares name, universe levels, type and safety only, not the body (read from upstream Comparator source in an earlier session, 2026-10-07; Comparator/Compare.lean is not present in the local clone, so this lane does not re-verify that claim). This lane is a statement review, not a numeric test: it has no numeric threshold.
status_of_upstream: Challenge and solution files are claims by another model (openai/math @ adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a). Nothing is compiled or elaborated in this lane.

inputs.solution_search_space: the import closure of each config's solution_module, following only `import X` lines whose file <lean_root>/X.lean exists (Mathlib and other external imports are not searched). A declaration in an OAI file outside that closure does not count.

method.extraction: Comment-stripped (line comments, nested block comments, doc comments; string literals kept), column-0 declarations of kind def/abbrev/theorem/lemma/instance/structure/inductive/class/opaque/axiom/example/irreducible_def (with optional @[..] attributes and private/protected/noncomputable/partial/unsafe/nonrec modifiers). A declaration ends at the next column-0 command line. Fully qualified names from a namespace/section stack (namespace A.B pushes one scope per component; `end X.Y` pops as many scopes as X.Y has components, bare `end` pops one; dotted declaration names extend the prefix; _root_. resets it). Universe suffixes .{u} are stripped from the name. The active open/variable/universe/omit/include lines of each declaration's scope are recorded as context, not compared.
method.comparison: Token streams after the declaration name (signature + body) are compared. Whitespace and comments are irrelevant by construction. Two streams are equal up to bound-variable renaming iff they have the same length, every non-identifier token is equal, and differing identifiers form a single consistent bijection in which both members are bound on their own side (binder positions: after fun/λ/∀/∃/∃!/∑/∏/⋃/⋂/∫/∮/Π/Σ/let/have up to a terminator; leading identifiers of a bracket group followed by ':' '//' or '|'; pattern variables of a match arm '|' ... '=>' where the '|' is at depth 0 or after with/fun at its depth). A dotted token x.f may match y.f when x->y is such a renaming. Dotted global names, keywords and free identifiers must match exactly. No other equivalences: fun vs λ, => vs ↦, Finset.univ vs univ under `open Finset`, notation vs its unfolding are all DIFFERS mechanically.
method.kind_rule: A declaration-kind mismatch (e.g. abbrev vs def) is DIFFERS, because reducibility changes elaboration.
method.sorry_rule: SORRIED_IN_CHALLENGE iff the comment-stripped challenge declaration contains a `sorry` or `admit` token. Recorded separately: challenge_sorry_only (everything after the signature is `sorry`, `by sorry` or `admit`) vs a body that merely contains a sorry (e.g. `decreasing_by sorry`), and whether the solution declaration contains sorry/admit. The challenge-side fields are recorded even when the solution side is NOT_FOUND.
method.shadowing: For each hole found in the solution closure, shadow_candidates lists names prefix.ident, for every free (unbound, non-keyword) identifier ident of the solution declaration and every prefix of its own namespace or a namespace opened in its context, that are declared in the solution closure but not in the challenge file (other hole names excluded). context_differs flags any difference between the recorded open/variable/universe context lines of the two sides. Neither changes the mechanical verdict.

verdict_categories.NOT_FOUND: no declaration of the hole's full name in the challenge file, or none in the solution import closure (file:line hints from a raw-text search are attached for the eye check)
verdict_categories.AMBIGUOUS: more than one declaration of the full name on one side; treated as a parser flag, never resolved by choosing one
verdict_categories.SORRIED_IN_CHALLENGE: the challenge's definition is sorry'd: a genuine hole; the theorem's meaning depends on the solution's definition and is flagged, not resolved
verdict_categories.MATCHES: same kind and token-identical up to whitespace, comments and a bound-variable bijection (the renaming map is recorded)
verdict_categories.DIFFERS: anything else; the first differing token, whether it lies in the signature or the body, and a +-10 token window from each side are quoted

decision_rule: Mechanical verdicts are assigned in the fixed order NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS, SORRIED_IN_CHALLENGE, kind check, MATCHES, DIFFERS by scripts/openai_math/d1_hole_bodies.py at the sha256 below; the code is not edited between preregistration and the run. If a defect forces an edit, the edit, the new sha256 and the reason are disclosed in the result, and controls and the full run are repeated.

Every MATCHES and DIFFERS verdict (and every renaming map) is then checked by eye against the source, with the recorded open/variable/universe context of both sides. The eye review is stored separately (eye_verdict, note, meaning_pinned) and never overwrites the mechanical verdict; every disagreement is listed in eye_disagreements.

A hole whose meaning cannot be pinned (SORRIED_IN_CHALLENGE, NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS, a DIFFERS whose semantic effect cannot be settled by reading, or a MATCHES whose surrounding context differs in a way that could change elaboration) is reported with meaning_pinned=false, not resolved. This lane never upgrades DIFFERS to MATCHES; text comparison is not elaboration, and elaborated Expr comparison is deferred to D2.

A MATCHES with a non-empty shadow_candidates list or context_differs=true gets meaning_pinned=false unless the by-eye check reads every shadow candidate and context difference and records why it cannot change the elaborated meaning.
Results count only if every control in controls.json passes (all_pass=true). A failing control means the run is reported as a crash, not as verdicts.

positive: self: each of the nine challenge files compared with itself: every hole MATCHES (or SORRIED_IN_CHALLENGE where the challenge declaration contains sorry)
layout: each challenge vs a copy with indentation changed, trailing line comments and a nested block comment added: same verdict as self
alpha_rename_bound: EuclideanFiveColor with bound variables point/otherPoint renamed to p/q: ProperColoring MATCHES
negative: neg_body_true: KServer `def MainStatement : Prop := True` (the D2 attack Comparator would accept): DIFFERS
neg_global_swap_dist_edist: KServer serviceCost `dist` -> `edist` (undotted global): DIFFERS, not a renaming
neg_sorried_challenge: EuclideanFiveColor challenge with ProperColoring's body replaced by sorry: SORRIED_IN_CHALLENGE
controls.where: d1_hole_bodies.py controls --root <lean_root> --out <lane>; mutated copies are written to <lane>/controls/, results to <lane>/controls.json

outputs.chunks: <lane>/chunks/<Name>.json (one per challenge; reruns skip finished chunks)
outputs.eye_review: <lane>/eye_review.json (written by hand during the by-eye check)

budget.cpu: 1 core, reading and small scripts only (no Lean, no lake, no LLM)
budget.time: each Bash call < 2 min; whole lane (controls + 9 chunks + eye review) within one session

code.interpreter: /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.10.12), pytest 9.1.1; hypothesis is NOT installed for this interpreter, so the one Hypothesis property test is skipped

smoke_test_disclosure.unit_tests: /usr/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/openai_math/test_d1_hole_bodies.py -q -p no:cacheprovider -> 22 passed, 1 skipped (Hypothesis property test; hypothesis not installed). All on synthetic Lean snippets and a tmp-dir import tree. An earlier version of the code (before the namespace-stack, sorry-field, shadowing and irreducible_def changes suggested in review) gave 18 passed, 1 skipped.
real_files_touched_before_preregistratio: Read by eye during orientation: the nine config JSONs (hole names and solution modules), challenge files EuclideanFiveColor.lean, KServer.lean, Rokhlin.lean and the first 70 lines of ElementaryPositivity.lean (its single hole elementaryPositivityWitness is visibly `:= by sorry` in the challenge), and only the import/namespace/section/open/variable lines of the solution files OAI/Combinatorics/KServer/Main.lean and OAI/Dynamics/MultipleMixing/Main.lean (no solution definition bodies were read).
A substring-presence check confirmed that each control mutation applies to the real EuclideanFiveColor/KServer challenge files (all True). No comparison of any challenge against any solution was run.

Prior knowledge: docs/OPENAI_MATH_STUDY.md (earlier session) records a by-eye reading that KServer's MainStatement in OAI/Combinatorics/KServer/Main.lean:123 matches the challenge up to renamed bound variables. That is a prior expectation, not a result of this lane.
smoke_test_disclosure.instrument_check_challenge_side: extract_decls run on the nine challenge .lean files only (no solution file): of the 45 hole names, 45 found exactly once in their challenge file, 0 missing, 0 duplicated. No verdict was computed.
